versions.subject: feat: updates and new rules related to fin7
versions.detection:
selection_sql:
    Image|endswith: '\sqlcmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'VeeamBackup'
        - 'From '
selection_db:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'BackupRepositories'
        - 'Backups'
        - 'Credentials'
        - 'HostCreds'
        - 'SmbFileShares'
        - 'Ssh_creds'
        - 'VSphereInfo'
condition: all of selection_*
